# Product σ-algebra on configuration space is generated by the coordinates

**Product σ-algebra on configuration space is generated by the coordinates.** The product σ-algebra on `ConfigSpace E` is generated by the coordinate projections; this
holds by definition of `MeasurableSpace.pi`.
